title: The Gym Where You See TOMORROW
premise: The gym mirror shows you tomorrow, so when my best friend asks for my savings tonight, tomorrow-me mouths 'don't say yes', and later, 'say yes tonight'.
twist: Each warning's glass shows a date that isn't tomorrow, one two days ahead and one today, so I can't tell which day the mirror was really showing or which me to trust.
world: One small bright gym: teal walls, an orange rubber floor, black racks and benches, a wall-to-wall mirror with a thick chrome edge, and a white flip-number date board on the back wall.
